column_axis: Genomic position · 1-Mb windows over exported intervals
row_order: Deterministic CNV-score rank sampling, then within-group Ward clustering of reported-region profiles.
note: Reference rows use the source-defined diploid baseline; grey marks missing observation intervals. Status strip follows the exact sccnvmap.pred field; missing predictions are Unknown.
status_annotation: Reference = source-defined reference; scATAC statuses use the exact exported sccnvmap.pred field; missing/other values = Unknown.
reference_display_policy: scATAC reference rows use the source-defined diploid baseline; observation rows without interval calls remain NaN/grey.
group_count_labels: displayed / total exported cells in the group

exports.display_layer: scRNA uses signed prevalence with square-root contrast; scATAC uses linear chromosome-preserving means; source features retained.
exports.group_layout: Minimum group height for label readability; heights do not encode population sizes.

statistics: Descriptive visualization; cells are not independent biological replicates; no significance tests.
